# ANTIMICROBIAL COST INFORMATION

Cost is represented as dollar ($) signs in parenthesis following the antibiotic.

The number of $ signs represent the cost ranges below:

$ = Less than 10 dollars per day

$$ = 10-50 dollars per day

$$$ = 51-100 dollars per day

$$$$ = 101-400 dollars per day

$$$$ = Greater than 400 dollars per day

The displayed cost of an antibiotic is an estimate based on usual daily doses

for an 80kg patient. Costs may change frequently due to VA contract negotiations

as well as supply and demand effects. Antibiotic cost and formulary are reviewed

by members of the Antimicrobial Subcommittee annually.
